newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS, United Airlines get alliance approval.
newsitem.headline: SAS, United Airlines get alliance approval.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Tuesday that the U.S. Department of Transport had granted it and United Airlines antitrust immunity for the two airlines' marketing alliance.
"This means that SAS and United can extend and strengthen their marketing cooperation and develop an effective, global network of services to the benefit of travellers," SAS said in a statement.
It said the Department of Transport had also given antitrust immunity for the three-party alliance between SAS, United and Lufthansa.
"The approval of our application for immunity...is an important legal milestone in the continued development of our cooperation," SAS said.
The two companies entered into an alliance in September 1995 regarding code share flights over the North Atlantic, the U.S. and Europe.
SAS said the immunity would allow them to integrate their traffic and line planning to help them compete against other global alliances.
"SAS and United will now be looking closer at the potential synergies in marketing and distribution, information systems, purchasing and joint product development," SAS said.
